729150101.text: The blades aren't exactly the same as the ones in Liyue.

729150102.text: Yeah, the materials and methods used to forge the weapons aren't the same, so the resulting weapons would be of a different style as well.

729150103.text: I heard that Liyue's Archon, Rex Lapis, was skilled at the forging of weapons. Previously, I was curious about what the blades made in Liyue were like.

729150104.text: So a while ago, I requested someone from the Crux Fleet to bring a weapon made in Liyue to me. I learned a lot after studying that weapon.

729150105.text: Now, I have fully grasped the techniques that were used to forge that weapon. Seeing as you have deep connections with Liyue, I'll gift this weapon to you.
